citation: Bird, C. S., Bo, A. P. L., Lu, W., & Dick, T. J. M. (2026). Data from: Ultra-wideband radar to measure in vivo muscle forces. Dryad Digital Repository. https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.sbcc2frmh; Science Robotics, 11(116), eaed5865. https://doi.org/10.1126/scirobotics.aed5865; arXiv:2510.20866
title: Ultra-wideband radar to measure in vivo muscle forces
institution: The University of Queensland / CSIRO Health and Biosecurity / Oslo Metropolitan University
cohort_size: 54 recruitment events across 4 distinct protocols (16 isometric knee, 18 fatiguing isometric knee, 6 dynamic knee, 6 isometric ankle)
measurements_present: Biodex isokinetic dynamometer knee joint torque (passive, isokinetic, isotonic)
Forsentek 3-axis load cell knee torque and DACELL ankle dorsiflexion torque
Joint angle (0 to 90 degrees) and angular velocity (30, 60, 90, 120 deg/s)
B-mode ultrasound vastus lateralis and tibialis anterior fascicle length, pennation, velocity (Telemed 100 Hz, UltraTrack v5.0)
Surface EMG vastus lateralis (2048 Hz, normalized to MVC)
Ultra-wideband radar S11 and S21 scattering parameters (100 MHz to 2.9 GHz across 51 frequencies, 10.8 Hz)
20-minute fatiguing intermittent isometric knee extension protocol
